archetypes.name: dyn-recovery-state
archetypes.rationale: bail-overlay clearance writes three state layers atomically; post-read verification is the only correctness guard
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on ship_recovery.py reconcile_manual_merge_main. Verify that _write_terminal_layer correctly clears every key in RECONCILE_TERMINAL_DONE_CLEAR_FIELDS across all three layers (ship-pr-state.sh, finalize-state.sh, session-env.sh). Check _verify_reconciliation: does it catch partial writes where one layer still has BAIL_NEEDS_USER_INPUT or EXIT_CODE non-zero? Verify that no write occurs before the merged PR probe succeeds. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
